app.avisoG2: We do not store your data on any server.
app.descripcion: Your digital business card. We do not store your data on any server.

home.tagline: Your digital business card, with no account and no server.
home.comoFunciona: You fill in your details, they stay on this device, and you share your card as a QR code, as an image, or as a contact file.

editor.subtitulo: It saves itself on this device while you type.
editor.fotoAyuda: It gets resized and stripped of metadata before being saved. It never travels inside the QR code or the link.
editor.fotoTipoNoSoportado: That file does not look like an image.
editor.fotoFallo: The image could not be processed. Try another one.
editor.fotoNoGuardada: The photo could not be saved in this browser.
editor.imagenFallo: The image could not be created in this browser.
editor.imagenNoGuardada: The image could not be saved.
editor.vcfFallo: This browser does not allow downloading the file.
editor.faltaNombre: Type at least your name to be able to share.
editor.faltaConfirmacion: Tick the confirmation above to be able to share.
editor.notaImagen: The image comes out the size of a phone, with your QR code inside. It is created right here: it does not leave this device.
editor.falloGuardado: Could not save in this browser

campos.titularPlaceholder: Get back the hours your operation takes from you.
campos.descripcionPlaceholder: Your team drops the repetitive work and goes back to what matters.
campos.descripcionAyuda: Up to two sentences: why people look for you.
campos.descripcionAviso: Anything fits here, so avoid sensitive data (health, affiliations, beliefs). Everything you write travels in the card you hand out.
campos.ciudadAviso: It shows on the top line of the card. If you prefer an exact address, think about whether you want it to be your home: you are going to hand this card out.

avisos.alcanceTitulo: This app is for YOUR own card.
avisos.alcanceCuerpo: If you make someone else's, their data stays on this phone and in this phone's backups. The image you save goes to your Photos, and the contact to your address book.
avisos.confirmacion: I confirm this card is mine, or that I have the person's permission to share their data.
avisos.borrarTodo: Delete my data from this device

limites.equipo: Your card lives in this browser, on this device. If you clear the site data or change phones, you lose it: there is no account to recover it from.
limites.respaldo: The image you save is your backup.
limites.senal: You need a connection the first time you open the app.
limites.enlaceIrrevocable: A link you have already handed out cannot be switched off. The data travels inside the link, so there is no server where it could be deleted.

tarjeta.sinTarjeta: There is no card on this device yet.
tarjeta.escanea: Scan to save me in your contacts

qr.alt: QR code with this card's contact details
qr.fallo: The code could not be generated in this browser. The phone number below still works.
qr.noDisponible: The QR code is not available.
qr.densidad: Your code came out very dense ({modulos}×{modulos} squares). It may be hard to scan from another screen.
qr.densidadRecorte: Your code came out very dense ({modulos}×{modulos} squares). It may be hard to scan from another screen. Removing {campo} lightens it the fastest.

enlace.intro: If you prefer, you can send your card as a link. It is not required: the QR code and the image already work without it.
enlace.publico: Your data travels inside the link. Anyone who has it can see it, with no password.
enlace.irrevocable: <fuerte>It cannot be switched off afterwards.</fuerte> There is no server where it could be deleted: whatever you hand out stays alive forever. If you edit your card, a new link is created and the old one keeps showing the old version.
enlace.historial: The link stays in the <fuerte>browser history</fuerte> of whoever opens it, and if that person has sync turned on, it is copied to their other devices. We cannot prevent that from here.

errores.vacio: This link does not carry any card. It may have been cut off when it was copied.
errores.ilegible: This card could not be read. The link looks incomplete or got broken when it was copied.
errores.version-desconocida: This link was created by a newer version of the app and cannot be read here.
errores.datos-invalidos: This card arrived with data that cannot be displayed.
